metadata.title: When you accidentally win the fight nobody remembers happening
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just get that kill or did the game glitch?
My aim wasn’t invited but showed up anyway.
VALORANT physics be like: ‘Sure, why not?’

Click if you’ve ever won by accident!

Hit play if your kills are more accident than skill!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #shorts
